seen.extent: 10 pp. Latin, part cipher.
seen.cipher: L&P: 'Hol., pp.10, Lat., part cipher, undeciphered. Add. f.211.' Clear Latin about the tenth, the Tournai bull and Peter Vannes' collectorship is quoted around it; no decipher. The heading is 'Silvester Bp. of Worcester to Wolsey': Gigli, Henry VIII's ambassador at Rome.

seen.where: https://archive.org/details/10278829bsb (OCR of L&P II pt 2): Spinelly despatch of 2 Apr 1518, Arranda, before no. 4057.
seen.extent: 9 pages, mostly cipher.
